modalities.value: image and language (vision encoder + multimodal LLM; grounded image-text)

source.quote:
Following KOSMOS -1, a vision encoder and a resampler module are
used to obtain image embeddings for input images.
The total number of trainable parameters amounts to approximately 1.6B.

architecture.value: Vision encoder (24 layers, 1024 hidden, 4096 FFN) + 24-layer MAGNETO Transformer LLM (2048 hidden, 32 heads, 8192 FFN); 224x224 image, 14x14 patches, 32x32 location tokens; built on Kosmos-1

source.quote:
The multimodal large language model component is a 24-layer M AGNETO
Transformer [WMH+ 22, MWH+ 22] with 2,048 hidden dimensions, 32 attention heads, and 8,192
FFN intermediate size.

trainingData.value: GRIT grounded image-text (~91M images from COYO-700M and LAION-2B subsets) plus Kosmos-1 multimodal corpora (text, image-caption, interleaved); instruction tuning on LLaVA-Instruct, Unnatural Instructions, FLANv2, and grounded GRIT instructions

source.quote:
We train the model on newly added grounded image-text pairs, monomodal text
corpora, image-caption pairs, and interleaved image-text data.

trainingCompute.value: 60k steps (~25B tokens) on 256 V100 GPUs, about one day; AdamW lr 2e-4

source.quote:
We train the model
on 256 V100 GPUs and the training takes approximately one day to complete.

findings.text: The paper forbids creating unsuitable material with the model and says Microsoft AI Principles were applied during development, but reports no safety tests or scores.

source.quote:
The utilization
of the model to create unsuitable material is strictly forbidden and not endorsed by this work.

notes: Technical report (arXiv 2306.14824), not a system card. No safety, alignment, refusal, jailbreak, bias, toxicity, privacy, or dangerous-capability evaluations. Ethics Statement (p.11) is a usage policy plus a claim that Microsoft AI Principles were put into practice; it does not report tests or topic-specific results, so all topics are uncovered. Per pilot safety-only rule, evalResults is empty. Skipped capability tables: Table 2 (Flickr30k Entities phrase grounding), Table 3 (RefCOCO/RefCOCO+/RefCOCOg referring comprehension), Table 4 (RefCOCOg referring generation), Table 5 (Flickr30k captioning, VQAv2), Table 6 (Winograd, Winogrande, PIQA, BoolQ, CB, COPA, StoryCloze, HellaSwag). Seed model microsoft/kosmos-2-patch14-224 matches the reported 224x224 / 14x14 vision setup and is the report's subject.
